desc: Correct the first-forbidden-vertex decomposition to account for forbidden starting blocks and ensure continuation regions are disjoint and complete.
Derive \(F(x,y)=\binom{x+y+2}{x+1}-1\) for unrestricted paths ending at \((x,y)\).
Derive the rectangle sum \(Q(a,b)\) using binomial prefix identities.
Derive the continuation sum \(T(a,b)\) for paths from a first forbidden vertex.
Verify degenerate rectangles and rectangles touching town boundaries.
Validate the corrected implementation against all provided samples and boundary configurations.
Specify factorial and inverse-factorial precomputation modulo 998244353.
